cohort: 295 uncomplicated monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies delivered after 36 weeks' gestation over a 10-year period
finding: Trial of labor did not significantly influence the perinatal outcomes of monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies delivered at ≥36 weeks' gestation.
mod_finding: For uncomplicated monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies at or beyond 36 weeks' gestation, a trial of labor did not appear to negatively influence perinatal outcomes compared to planned cesarean section.
